paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Yevamot 34a, where he raised a difficulty to Rav Nachman,[^3] and there at [112a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.112a.7), where he asked Rav Nachman a question. See the entry Huna son of Rav Nachman.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The heading form is Hon; the cross-reference form is Huna. The second question is asked of Rav Nachman, not by him.
The linked Yevamot passage has Hon son of Rav Nachman ask Rav Nachman a question. The 34a attribution is Hyman’s report. His cross-reference gives the form Huna.

At [Yevamot 34b:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.34b.5), Hon son of Rav Nachman asks Rav Nachman whether Rabbi Yehudah’s ruling is meant to spare a bride’s adornments. Rav Nachman gives a different reason. Hyman cites 34a.
